title: Castle of Good Hope

terrainReference.basis: Original mapped approach gate immediately outside the named main entrance sets the fixed approximate dry approach datum before terrain acquisition.

note: Complete original five-bastion fort, both open yards, cross-wing and separate island wing on the signed native relation. Kat pediment belongs inside the courtyard. Fixed native entrance approach datum; yard and foundation terrain attachment approximate. No moat/whole-site platform or neighboring city reconstruction.
